sources.title: Synthetic evaluation fixture: randomized trial
sources.abstract: In this synthetic evaluation trial, 240 adults were randomized to intervention A or placebo. At 12 weeks, HbA1c was 0.5 percentage points lower with intervention A than placebo (95% CI 0.2 to 0.8 percentage points lower). This was a between-group difference. Mortality was not measured. The trial does not establish effects beyond 12 weeks.
